sources.excerpt: Security patches are also backported to `vite@6.4` and `vite@8.1`.
sources.observation: The current policy also gives 8.3 regular patches and 7.3/8.2 important and security patches; older minors are unsupported.

sources.excerpt: while retaining compatibility with Vite 6 and 7.
sources.observation: Stable v6.0.0 is the current release; its new config bundler is Rolldown. Official release body was saved in the workspace research capture.
Documented Fast Refresh React minimum includes unchanged React 18.3.1. Default automatic JSX runtime and react() configuration remain supported.

v5.2.0 expands the Vite peer range while retaining Vite 6. The v5 changes remove implicit react/react-dom resolve.dedupe entries; the application has a single unchanged React 18.3.1 pair and no configuration adaptation is introduced absent a demonstrated failure.

### Add Vite 8 to peerDependencies range [#1143](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/pull/1143)

This plugin is compatible with Vite 8.
